name: Mac file walkthrough
description: Create a unique text file in Terminal, append a line, and open the verified file in TextEdit.
intro: Welcome. This Mac rehearsal shows a small file moving from Terminal to a visible document window.

steps.title: Create a sample file in Terminal
steps.say: I write the first line of a new text file in the selected folder.

steps.title: Append and print a second line
steps.say: I add a second line and print the complete file in Terminal.

steps.title: Open the file in TextEdit
steps.say: I open the resulting document and read both lines in TextEdit.
